title: Poisoneer
description: An Origin datapack that ands Poisoneer to the game
body:
## Passives

### Ratling 
- You are 15% smaller and take 40% more damage when being hit by someone who has more than 18 hp.

### Shadow magic 
- If you are sneaking you cover yourself with shadows and gain true invisibility, that hides you even if you are glowing. You move slower and automatically destroy torches around you If you stop sneaking but not moving you are still invisible.

### Rapid movement
- You move faster than an ordinary human, when you sprint you gradually increase your movement speed and jump height even more. When you are drawing your bow you are not losing speed.

### Poisoned arrows
- Your damage with arrows is set to 1 but your arrows inflict poison on your targets for 10 seconds. Each time you hit a target that already has a poison effect, the poison effect will increase its level by 1. Undead targets instead get wither effect.

### Cursed touch
- Your melee attacks apply curse on your targets, making them more vulnerable to magic, withering, hunger and poison damage. Each stack increases damage taken by 25%. The maximum amount of stacks is 20. Target loses 2 stacks every 10 seconds if it hasn't been hit. Decreases healing target takes by 25% for each 5 stacks

### Clumsy
- You can't use axes, getting hit prevents you from using bows for 10 seconds and you gain a clumsy stack every time you hit someone. Each stack decreases damage you deal by 15% and if you hit someone when you have 5 stacks your weapon will slip out of your hand and you will return to 2 stacks. If you kill your target you lose all stacks.
 
## Active abilities: 

### [Primary] Disarming attack 
- Lunge forward, disarming opponent on the next hit.
-#Disarmed opponents deal no damage and get 1 additional curse stack when hit for next 5 seconds.

### [Secondary] Dark bomb 
- Deploy a magic bomb on the creature you are aiming at, rooting it for 3 seconds. After 12 seconds it will explode dealing 4 magic damage.
